name: Campo Mourão (Brazil)
description: White field with a dark grey lozenge outline, charged at the centre with the municipal arms between branches.
history: Campo Mourão is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 26 September 1964 (chosen by popular vote, designed by the artist Augusto Conte and adopted by Law No. 32 of 26 September 1964, modified by Law No. 22 of 2 October 1973, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown between branches
